title: Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP/1.1): Semantics and Content
summary: Defines what HTTP/1.1 messages mean: request methods, header fields, response status codes, payload handling, and content negotiation. It is one of the documents that replaced RFC 2616. It was later replaced by RFC 9110.

eli5.summary: This explains what words like GET and POST mean when your browser talks to a website, and what the website's answers mean. It has since been replaced by a newer version.

questions: what do http status codes mean
